units.source_text: “无论如何，很难想象他们那些卑劣的人竟然和你们这些忠臣同处一藩。

en.t: In any case, it is hard to imagine that such vile men could belong to the same domain as loyal retainers like you.

units.source_text: 可能就是因为这样，不止是武士，就连普通百姓也都在唾弃那些尸位素餐的卑劣武士。

en.t: Perhaps for that very reason, not only the samurai but even ordinary commoners despise those vile warriors who draw their stipends while doing nothing.

units.source_text: 据说去年冈林杢之助官老爷是被亲戚们逼迫才切腹自尽的。

en.t: It is said that last year Lord Okabayashi Mokunosuke was forced by his relatives to commit seppuku.

units.source_text: 不过就是不遭遇被迫，事已至此，恐怕也不得不承担污名。

en.t: But even if he had not been forced, with matters having come this far, he probably would have had to bear the disgrace.
All the more so for the others.

units.source_text: 江户本地人原本就崇尚见义勇为，现如今效仿各位报仇雪恨，很久之前百姓们就为此感到愤慨，没准什么时候就把这些卑劣之人杀了呢。”

en.t: Edo natives have always admired righteous courage, and now, following your example of avenging wrongs, the common people have long been indignant; at any moment they may kill those vile men.
